functions.name: Customer service
functions.description: Answering, routing and resolving customer requests after the sale.

functions.name: Finance and accounting
functions.description: Recording, reconciling, closing, forecasting and paying.

functions.name: People and recruiting
functions.description: Hiring, onboarding, policy and employee questions.

functions.name: Procurement
functions.description: Sourcing, comparing, contracting with and monitoring suppliers.

functions.name: Supply chain and logistics
functions.description: Forecasting demand, holding stock, moving goods.

functions.name: Marketing
functions.description: Content, campaigns, experiments and brand monitoring.

functions.name: Sales operations
functions.description: Leads, outreach, calls and CRM hygiene.

functions.name: IT operations and security
functions.description: Internal requests, alerts, access and internal knowledge.

functions.name: Software engineering
functions.description: Building, reviewing, testing and operating software: the delivery capability for every other function.

jobs.name: Resolve tier-1 support requests without a human
jobs.outcome: A routine customer request (password reset, order status, how-do-I) is answered correctly and closed with no person handling it.

jobs.name: Flag customers likely to leave from their interactions
jobs.outcome: Accounts whose conversations, usage and tone point to churn are flagged early enough to act.

jobs.name: Draft replies a support agent sends with light edits
jobs.outcome: A support agent receives a drafted reply grounded in the customer's history and the knowledge base and sends it with minor edits or none.

jobs.name: Score every support interaction against the quality rubric
jobs.outcome: Each interaction receives a quality score consistent with a trained reviewer's, so coaching needs no sampling.

jobs.name: Summarize a customer conversation for the next handler
jobs.outcome: A conversation of any length is condensed into what was asked, what was done and what is open, and the next handler needs nothing else.

jobs.name: Route incoming tickets to the right queue
jobs.outcome: Every new ticket lands in the queue and priority a trained agent would have chosen, before a person reads it.

jobs.name: Implement a scoped change from a written task
jobs.outcome: A task with clear scope becomes a mergeable change that passes tests and review with limited rework.

jobs.name: Investigate incidents to a root cause
jobs.outcome: An incident is investigated from logs, metrics and changes to a root cause a responder confirms.

jobs.name: Keep dependencies current and safe
jobs.outcome: Dependency updates are proposed, tested and merged, and known vulnerabilities are closed within the policy window.

jobs.name: Review pull requests for defects and risks
jobs.outcome: A pull request receives review comments that find real defects and risks a careful reviewer would, with few false alarms.

jobs.name: Triage incoming issues and reproduce them
jobs.outcome: New issues are labeled, deduplicated and reproduced or marked unreproducible, with the steps recorded.

jobs.name: Write and maintain documentation from the code
jobs.outcome: Documentation is written from the code and kept current as it changes, and readers find what they need.

jobs.name: Write tests that cover a change or a module
jobs.outcome: Tests are added that fail on the defect and pass on the fix, and coverage of the changed code rises.

jobs.name: Categorize expenses to the chart of accounts
jobs.outcome: Every expense lands in the account and cost center a controller would choose.

jobs.name: Draft the commentary explaining budget variances
jobs.outcome: Each material variance in the monthly pack carries a draft explanation grounded in the underlying transactions.

jobs.name: Flag transactions that look wrong before they post
jobs.outcome: Duplicates, unusual amounts, odd counterparties and policy breaches are flagged before money moves.

jobs.name: Forecast cash position over the coming weeks
jobs.outcome: A rolling cash forecast that a treasurer trusts for the next 13 weeks, updated as receivables and payables move.

jobs.name: Match supplier invoices to purchase orders and receipts
jobs.outcome: An incoming invoice is matched to its order and receipt lines, with exceptions surfaced, without manual keying.

jobs.name: Reconcile bank and ledger balances
jobs.outcome: Bank lines and ledger entries are matched and every unmatched item is explained or queued, by the close date.

jobs.name: Answer employees' policy and benefits questions
jobs.outcome: An employee's question about leave, benefits or policy is answered correctly from the handbook, or routed when it cannot be.

jobs.name: Draft a job description from a hiring brief
jobs.outcome: A hiring manager's brief becomes a posting that needs light edits and passes the compliance review.

jobs.name: Schedule interviews across candidates and panels
jobs.outcome: Interview slots are booked across candidate and panel calendars without back-and-forth.

jobs.name: Screen applications against the role's requirements
jobs.outcome: Every application is scored against the stated requirements with reasons a recruiter can read and override.

jobs.name: Summarize engagement survey comments into themes
jobs.outcome: Free-text survey comments become themes with representative quotes and counts a leader can act on.

jobs.name: Answer questions from the company's internal knowledge
jobs.outcome: A question about how things work here is answered from the wiki and documents, with the source, or routed.

jobs.name: Detect anomalous access to systems and data
jobs.outcome: Logins and data access that break a user's pattern are flagged for review before harm.

jobs.name: Resolve routine IT requests without a technician
jobs.outcome: Password resets, access requests and how-do-I questions are resolved end to end with no technician.

jobs.name: Triage monitoring alerts to the right responder
jobs.outcome: Alerts are deduplicated, grouped and routed to the right responder with the context to act.

jobs.name: Answer compliance questions from the policy corpus
jobs.outcome: A question about what the rules allow is answered with the policy passage that says so, or routed.

jobs.name: Extract obligations and dates from signed contracts
jobs.outcome: Every obligation, deadline and renewal in a contract is extracted into the register with its clause.

jobs.name: Monitor regulatory changes that affect the business
jobs.outcome: Changes in the regulations the company is subject to are detected, summarized and mapped to the affected policies.

jobs.name: Review a non-disclosure agreement against the playbook
jobs.outcome: An incoming NDA is marked up against the company playbook, with deviations explained, before a lawyer looks.

jobs.name: Run A/B tests on creative and pick winners
jobs.outcome: Variants of headlines, images or copy are tested on live traffic and the winner is chosen by a stated method.

jobs.name: Draft campaign copy in the brand's voice
jobs.outcome: Copy for a campaign brief arrives in the brand's voice and passes review with light edits.

jobs.name: Monitor and summarize mentions of the brand
jobs.outcome: Mentions across the web and social are collected, classified by sentiment and topic, and summarized daily.

jobs.name: Optimize email creative per recipient
jobs.outcome: Subject lines, images and links vary per recipient and the campaign converts better than the single version.

jobs.name: Optimize a landing page's conversion rate
jobs.outcome: Changes to a landing page are tested and the page converts better than before at a stated confidence.

jobs.name: Personalize email content per segment or recipient
jobs.outcome: Each recipient sees content chosen for them and the campaign outperforms the unpersonalized version.

jobs.name: Publish and maintain a public web presence
jobs.outcome: Pages are written, published and kept current on a site the public reads, without a human in the publish path.

jobs.name: Classify spend into categories for analysis
jobs.outcome: Every transaction and line item is classified into the spend taxonomy consistently enough to negotiate on.

jobs.name: Compare supplier quotes on a like-for-like basis
jobs.outcome: Quotes with different structures are normalized and compared, with the differences that matter called out.

jobs.name: Draft a request for proposal from requirements
jobs.outcome: A stakeholder's requirements become an RFP that suppliers can answer without clarification rounds.

jobs.name: Monitor suppliers for risk signals
jobs.outcome: Financial, delivery, compliance and news signals about suppliers are watched and surfaced before they become incidents.

jobs.name: Draft personalized outreach messages
jobs.outcome: A first message to a prospect is drafted from what is known about them and sent with light edits.

jobs.name: Enrich leads with firmographic and contact data
jobs.outcome: Every new lead is completed with company size, industry, role and contact details from public sources.

jobs.name: Score leads by likelihood to convert
jobs.outcome: Leads are ranked so that working the top of the list converts more than working in order of arrival.

jobs.name: Summarize sales calls into notes and next steps
jobs.outcome: A recorded call becomes notes, objections and next steps a rep would have written.

jobs.name: Update the CRM from calls and emails
jobs.outcome: Fields, stages and next steps in the CRM change to reflect what happened in conversations, without manual entry.

jobs.name: Forecast demand per item and location
jobs.outcome: A demand forecast at the item and location level that beats the naive baseline and the previous method.

jobs.name: Plan delivery routes that cut miles and keep windows
jobs.outcome: Daily routes meet delivery windows with fewer miles and vehicles than the previous plan.

jobs.name: Propose reorders that keep service levels within stock targets
jobs.outcome: Reorder proposals hold the service level while lowering stock, and a planner approves most without change.

jobs.name: Detect shipments that will miss their window
jobs.outcome: Delays are detected from carrier and telemetry data early enough to re-plan or warn the customer.
